description: Mint a short-lived proof-of-possession token an agent presents to the gateway (TTL ≤ 30 minutes). The grant INCLUDING ITS ONE-TIME SECRET is written 0600 to the operator-configured home directory; the result references it by path only — hand the FILE to the agent process (e.g. @mandarelabs/sdk tokenCredentialsFromIssueJson), never paste its contents into chat.
